verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal exposes a broad API surface (custom POS integration, reader registration via serial/registration/order number, locations/zones fleet management, tips, receipts, refunds via Refunds API) that mirrors most Dashboard/UI capabilities, and Stripe's own OpenAPI spec exists for programmatic access. However, some flows (e.g., ordering readers, Smart Disputes automation, reader monitoring/configuration UI) are described as Dashboard-centric without explicit API equivalents, and no-code options are positioned as UI-first rather than API-parity features. Missing for 10: explicit API equivalents for reader ordering/monitoring dashboard actions, confirmation that Smart Disputes and other dashboard-only workflows are fully API-accessible, and independent hands-on verification of full parity.
